name: cvat
description: CVAT is a leading data annotation platform for image, video, audio, and 3D datasets. It offers open-source, cloud, and enterprise products, as well as labeling services, with AI-assisted labeling, quality assurance, team collaboration, analytics, and developer APIs.

latest_release.name: v2.83.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- Page-scoped state retention for tables and filter builders, preserving filters, search, sorting, column visibility, and pagination across remounts. Enabled for the validation frame table on the quality control page. (<https://github.com/cvat-ai/cvat/pull/11392>)

- Requirement names in annotation quality conflict cards. Names can also be shown in conflict tooltips by enabling `Settings` → `Workspace` → `Show requirements in conflict tooltips` (turned off by default) (<https://github.com/cvat-ai/cvat/pull/11423>)

### Fixed

- Unhandled Django exceptions are now included in server exception events (<https://github.com/cvat-ai/cvat/pull/11384>)
